item.title: Metallurgical Interface Engineering Constructing In Situ Li 3 N‐Enriched Interphase: A Bulk‐Interface Synergy Strategy Toward Practical Silicon Anodes
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in vacuum-suspension-melted bulk multiphase integration creating metallurgically bonded Si/metal interfaces, combined with an in situ Li₃N-enriched interphase from polydopamine-derived N-doped carbon. This bulk-interface synergy simultaneously addresses ionic, electronic, and mechanical limitations, enabling 87.3% retention over 1000 cycles, 5 Ah pouch cells, and wide-temperature operation—offering a practical route to durable high-energy Si anodes.

رقابت هیدرولیز-کوئوردیناسیون در Zn(TFA)2 پنجره حلالیت پنهانی ایجاد می‌کند و با افزودن استونیتریل، باتری آبی روی در دمای ‎−25 تا 30 درجه سانتی‌گراد چرخه‌پذیری پایدار نشان می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing nonmonotonic Zn(TFA)2 dissolution governed by a concentration-dependent hydrolysis-coordination balance, and using acetonitrile to widen the clear-solution window. This enables anion-derived interphases suppressing water reactions, yielding ultralong Zn//Zn cycling (8200 h at −25 °C) and high-retention Zn//PANI and Zn//I2 cells. It reframes electrolyte design around speciation and accessible solvation states rather than reported solubility.
🏷 aqueous zinc battery · Zn(TFA)2 electrolyte · hydrolysis-coordination balance · solid electrolyte interphase · wide-temperature operation

item.title: Beyond Lithium Solvation: Tuning Cation‐Solvent‐Anion Interactions for Stable Lithium‐Metal Batteries
item.description:
برهم‌کنش‌های سه‌گانه کاتیون-حلال-آنیون در الکترولیت‌های اتری فلوئوره‌شده روشن می‌شود و با مهار انحلال پلی‌سولفید، پایداری چرخه‌ای سلول‌های Li||S بهبود می‌یابد.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing that fluorinated ether solvents, considered non-solvating diluents, selectively solvate high-electron-donating anions via cation-solvent-anion ternary interactions. This revises conventional solvation views and offers a molecular framework for electrolyte design. Its significance is suppressing polysulfide shuttling, improving Li°||S cycling stability, and guiding solvent design for high-energy monovalent cation batteries.
🏷 lithium-metal battery · electrolyte solvation · cation-anion interaction · fluorinated ether · polysulfide shuttle

item.title: Electric‐Field Responsive Molecular Switch Unlocks Stable 4.5 V‐Class Sodium Layered Oxide Cathodes
item.description:
این مقاله یک عامل جفت‌شونده میدان الکتریکی به‌عنوان کلید مولکولی معرفی می‌کند که با تشکیل CEI خودمحدود، کاتد لایه‌ای سدیم را در ۴.۵ ولت پایدار می‌سازد.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in defining an electric field coupling agent that acts as a threshold-gated molecular switch, activated only above a critical interfacial field. This enables a self-limiting, gradient boron-rich interphase, achieving field-enhanced stability. Significance: it delivers stable 4.5 V sodium layered oxide cathodes (87.9% retention over 1000 cycles, 1 Ah pouch cells), offering a generalizable paradigm for on-demand high-voltage battery protection.
🏷 sodium layered oxide · high-voltage cathode · CEI · electric field · molecular switch
